<?php
function anon_typed_get_rhs(): int { echo "BADRHS;"; return 9; }
$o = new class {
    private int $yes = 100;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool {
        echo "I:", $incoming, ";";
        return $incoming === "yes";
    }
    public function __get(string $incoming) {
        echo "G:", $incoming, ";";
        return 7;
    }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BADSET;"; }
};
echo isset($o->no) ? "BAD;" : "LIF;";
echo isset($o->yes) ? "LIT;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($o->no) ? "LEF;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($o->yes) ? "BAD;" : "LET;";
echo ($o->no ?? 9) === 9 ? "LCF;" : "BAD;";
echo ($o->yes ?? 9) === 7 ? "LCT;" : "BAD;";
$name = "";
echo isset($o->$name) ? "BAD;" : "CIF;";
$name = "yes";
echo isset($o->$name) ? "CIT;" : "BAD;";
$name = "";
echo empty($o->$name) ? "CEF;" : "BAD;";
$name = "yes";
echo empty($o->$name) ? "BAD;" : "CET;";
$name = "";
echo ($o->$name ?? 9) === 9 ? "CCF;" : "BAD;";
$name = "yes";
echo ($o->$name ?? 9) === 7 ? "CCT;" : "BAD;";
echo ($o->yes ??= anon_typed_get_rhs()) === 7 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD;";
$only = new class {
    private int $yes = 100;
    public function __get(string $incoming) { echo "BADGET;"; return 7; }
};
echo empty($only->yes) ? "SKIP;" : "BAD;";
